liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Satisfaction** (2 reviews): Weir raps Wang Dang Doodle lyrics during the closer, a high-energy performance; Considered the best Satisfaction cover the Grateful Dead ever performed [12][20]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): This recording fixes the previously cut Peggy-O, while Loser remains incomplete [14]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The transition into Fire On The Mountain is phenomenal, showing Jerry's guitar practice [14]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Performed during a light drizzle, with raindrops audible on the Alpine pavilion roof [20]
- The transition from Space into The Other One is described as trippy and cool [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-08-08.141498.sbd.pcm.healy.streeter.lubar.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 174 min [1]
- **gd1982-08-08.144731.sbd.healy.streeter.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 23 songs; 179 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1982-08-08.167917.senn421.michael.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1644**: audience recording; 23 songs; 175 min [7]
- **gd82-08-08.sbd-wise.unknown.7690.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 170 min; rated 4.05/5 by 20 [11]. Said about its sound: Bobby plays a grunge-like guitar sound, sliding up and down the neck; The recording sounds good, though it is noted to be light on the Phil side; The recording contains enough musical, verbal, and audio flubs to feel like an off night [15][19][22]

## Around the show

- Guests Zakir Hussein and John Cipollina join the band for specific song segments [16]
- The band plays mellowly, focusing on soul rather than ego or technical perfection [17]
- An 18-year-old attendee took potent clear pyramids before the show, affecting the experience [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-08-08.141498.sbd.pcm.healy.streeter.lubar.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Frank Streeter and Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Harvey Lubar; source: Source Info: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony… [1]
- **gd1982-08-08.144731.sbd.healy.streeter.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Dan Healy & Frank Streeter; transferred by Matt Smitt, Scott Clugston, Charlier Miller; source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell… [5]. Also: Matt Smith azimuth-adjusted the transfer, using Beyer M160 FOB sources for crowd and patches [5]
- **gd1982-08-08.167917.senn421.michael.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Rodney Michael; transferred by Tim McKenzie;Charlie Miller;Scott Clugston; source: Rodney Michael's Master FOB (24th row) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M > DAT (x0) > Tim McKenzie's CDR's [7]
- **gd82-08-08.sbd-wise.unknown.7690.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; source: Soundboard [11]
